description: The uploaded file to add as a recording, with how to process it.

fileName.description: The `fileName` you asked the upload url for.

contentType.description: The `contentType` you asked the upload url for, when you sent one.

name.description: Name of the recording. Defaults to the file name without its extension.

expectedLanguages.description: Other languages that may be spoken.

subtitleProfiles.description: Subtitle profile id by language code, from `GET /v1/subtitle-profiles`.

numSpeakers.description: Number of speakers, when you know it.

ignoreTranscription.description: Keep the recording without transcribing it.
